title: Pacino Dwarf Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Yellow Dwarf Sunflower
description:
Discover the charm of the 'Pacino' Dwarf Sunflower, a delightful and compact variety perfect for adding vibrant colour to any garden space. These dwarf sunflowers produce bushy plants adorned with multiple bright yellow blooms, creating a long-lasting display from July through to October. Ideal for pots, containers, borders, and smaller gardens, 'Pacino' is easy to grow and a fantastic choice for attracting beneficial pollinators to your outdoor haven.

These sunflowers are known for their cheerful, daisy-like flowers with distinctive brown centres. Their manageable size makes them versatile for various planting schemes, bringing the joy of sunflowers without requiring vast amounts of space. Whether you're an experienced gardener or just starting, the 'Pacino' Dwarf Sunflower offers a rewarding and beautiful growing experience.
